summary: The Power Services leaf crate and the power application crate. The leaf exports 360 record helpers at the stock ABI through `stock_export!`; the application crate calls other owned units through C-ABI exports and keeps stock record-helper residue.

rows.kind: C-ABI bridge between two owned units
rows.other_side: application_nand, record_store, calibration_liveview, property_service, settings_storage, develop, task_submission, modal_runtime, display_scanout
rows.removal: every caller links the owning crate directly and both sides compare with stock in one image

evidence.requirement: The current record-helper ELF contains none of these application/client C-ABI symbols. The application arm-core library remains nonlinked here; each provider/client composition and its stock comparison are still required.

rows.shim: 360 stock-ABI record-helper exports through `stock_export!` in 45 files under `src/` (`record_native_exports.rs` defines the macro)
rows.other_side: stock record consumers that call the helper addresses
rows.removal: every record-helper caller is owned and the helpers are linked as Rust items

evidence.requirement: 360 stock-ABI record-helper exports through `stock_export!` in 45 files under `src/` (`record_native_exports.rs` defines the macro). stock record consumers that call the helper addresses. every record-helper caller is owned and the helpers are linked as Rust items

rows.shim: 14 `.S` residue files in `src/` (`native.S`, `record_task43_*`, `capture_profile_*`, `mode_*`, `serial_write_residue.S`, and the rest)
rows.other_side: stock bodies and register/stack frames the owned code must reproduce
rows.removal: the residue is no longer needed for stock callers or ABI parity

evidence.requirement: None of the 31 declared assembly entry symbols is linked into the current record-helper ELF. The residue-bearing application and service mechanisms remain nonlinked obligations; no frozen body is rebuilt for coverage.

rows.shim: ~1,200 retained `extern "C"` declarations in `src/` (record bodies, audio, capture profile, serial, timers)
rows.other_side: stock record, audio, capture and device services

evidence.requirement: The exact linked symbols and definite references are required in this composition. Caller closure, direct owned API migration and same-image comparison remain unestablished.
Only the explicit three kernel imports are bound by the current record-helper ELF. The broad conditional application extern inventory is not linked coverage or an established caller closure.

evidence.requirement: The callback registry entry and its audio consumer entries are absent from the current record-helper ELF. Their registry and callback-extent contracts remain nonlinked obligations.
